_doc: Genes that have not been shown to fire in any committed screen, and why.
The shape is `tools/inert_waivers.json`'s: a flat {tag: reason} map. Unlike
that file the reason is ENFORCED -- `tools/gene_fires.py` fails a waiver
shorter than 40 characters -- and a waiver goes STALE, failing the same
`--max 0` ratchet, the moment its gene is proven by a committed screen row
or leaves the gene tables. The list can only shrink.
Almost every entry here is grandfathered: it was in the tables before a new
gene had to show it fires. A gene added AFTER 2026-08-23 should not appear
here at all -- #2330 wrote rows for eighteen behaviours, the gate refused
four of them on their own probes, and those four were removed from the
To clear an entry: run a single-gene probe, which holds every other gene at
the baseline so any divergence is this gene alone, and commit the analysis --
-- then DELETE the entry here, or the stale-waiver check fails.

waivers.culture-and-religion-race-the-congress: Opt-in, live only: it acts solely in the Civ VI host's World Congress ballot (`CivvisCongressRacer`, tools/civ6_control/mod/CivvisControlAgent.lua, via `LaneCongressRacer` from tools/civ6_play.py); the simulator has no such Congress and never reads the field, so no screen can show it fire. congress_join_vote_test.lua drives the Lua side; the live proof is `wc_join_vote` rows and final Diplomatic Victory points on Culture and Religious seats (congress_kpi.py).
waivers.tribute-buys-the-friendship-2: Opt-in, live only: it acts solely in the live bridge (`civvis_orders::append_tribute_order`, the `past_the_line` aim and treasury rule), which the simulator never runs, and the opinion row a Civilization VI tribute buys is not modelled by the engine (`Game::do_trade`), so no screen can show it fire. `tribute_two_aims_past_the_line_from_the_whole_treasury` drives the bridge rule; a captured action-pair proof from an armed Deity game replaces this waiver.
